raw_source_audit.interpretation: Raw E57 files are absent at the paths recorded in the RCP. This prevents an independent raw-E57 point-count comparison; it does not establish that the RCS imports lost points.

registration_flag.meaning: XML manifest value only; native ReCap GUI registration state and resulting station placement were not visually verified.
